Unknown packaging: hpi — Jenkins HPI plugin parent POM / Maven HPI extension is not available in the local repository. None of the approved actions (Java/Maven/Ant home switches, build args, heap, or clean) can resolve a missing Maven packaging type. The fix requires source-level or plugin-resolution changes which are prohibited.

Previous decision (Java 8 + clean) was executed but the axis-ant module still fails in maven-antrun-plugin:1.7:run invoking Java2WsdlAntTask against src/test/ant/extra/build.xml. The -DskipTests flags do not skip antrun plugin executions bound to non-test phases. No allowed action can skip the antrun plugin, edit the POM, or pass a module-resume flag like -rf :axis-ant.

Apache Axis 1.x is a legacy project from the Java 8 era; building with Java 21 likely causes class-compatibility issues with the Java2WsdlAntTask that fails in the antrun plugin. Switching to Java 8 and cleaning stale artifacts is the safest first retry.

The toolchains-maven-plugin:4.5.0:toolchain goal requires a JDK toolchain definition in ~/.m2/toolchains.xml (vendor=temurin, version=21.0.1). The auto-install fallback fails because WORKSPACE_ROOT/.m2/jdks cannot be created. No approved action can suppress or satisfy the toolchains plugin requirement — there is no toolchain-skip flag in safe_build_args, set_java_home does not affect the plugin's toolchain resolution, and source edits are prohibited.
